## Official sources

Permit rules change, so check the agency that has jurisdiction over your address:

- [Florida Building Commission: product approval search](https://www.floridabuilding.org/pr/pr_app_srch.aspx)
- [Miami-Dade County: how to apply for a building permit](https://www.miamidade.gov/global/economy/building/how-to-apply-for-permit.page)
- [Miami-Dade Product Control: Notices of Acceptance](https://www.miamidade.gov/global/economy/board-and-code/product-approval.page)
- [Broward County Board of Rules and Appeals](https://www.broward.org/codeappeals)
- [Palm Beach County Permit Center](https://discover.pbc.gov/pzb/building/Pages/Permit-Center.aspx)
- [Florida Building Code 2023, Chapter 2: definition of the High Velocity Hurricane Zone](https://codes.iccsafe.org/content/FLBC2023P1/chapter-2-definitions)
